rows.grounds: adverbial phrase introducing a concessive turn
directional phrase pointing to the topic under discussion
indefinite pronoun introducing an additional item
passive present describing the forthcoming account
demonstrative referring to the account to be heard
imperative directing the listener to attend

items.question: What further description in that direction is now to be heard by the dear one?
premises: Even so, something is described in that direction.
The dear one is asked to hear that.
A further account follows despite prior statements.
items.inference: The verse introduces an additional description to be heard.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal referent of 'that direction' is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Even so, something in that direction is described; hear that, dear one.
